## LINES

_No moving lines._

### Traditional Chinese

#### Scripture

乾：元亨，利貞。

#### Exegesis

天行健，君子以自強不息。

### Simplified Chinese

#### Scripture

乾：元亨，利贞。

#### Exegesis

天行健，君子以自强不息。

### English, Wilhelm-Baynes

#### Scripture

THE CREATIVE works sublime success,
Furthering through perseverance.

#### Exegesis

The movement of heaven is full of power.
Thus the superior man makes himself strong and untiring.

### English, James Legge

#### Scripture

Khien (represents) what is great and originating, penetrating, advantageous, correct and firm.

#### Exegesis

I. Heaven, in its motion, (gives the idea of) strength. The superior man, in accordance with this, nerves himself to ceaseless activity.
